title: Time-Thief Mosquito
text: A small threat born of temporal shifts. These pale-green, monocled mosquitoes occasionally appear 3–5 blocks above the ground in time biomes.

A mosquito seeks a player and attaches for 5 seconds, then steals time from their equipment. Durability-bearing items in all four armor slots, both hands and the hotbar lose 10% of their maximum durability, rounded up. Each item is affected once; other inventory slots and accessory slots are unaffected.
After feeding, it gradually dissolves without dropping anything. Kill it before it succeeds to obtain 3–5 Time Warp Points.
